mulch.definition:
n. a protective covering of rotting vegetable matter spread to reduce evaporation and soil erosion
v. cover with mulch
mulch.translation:
n. 覆盖物, 护根, 根篱
vt. 铺护盖物, 做护根

mulched.translation: v. 用护根覆盖（植物根部或其周围地面）( mulch的过去式和过去分词 )

mulches.definition:
n a protective covering of rotting vegetable matter spread to reduce evaporation and soil erosion
v cover with mulch
mulches.translation: v. 用护根覆盖（植物根部或其周围地面）( mulch的第三人称单数 )

mulching.translation: v. 用护根覆盖（植物根部或其周围地面）( mulch的现在分词 )

mulct.translation:
n. 罚金
vt. 科以罚金, 抢夺

mulcted.translation: v. 处以罚金, 抢夺( mulct的过去式和过去分词 )

mulcting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Mulct
mulcting.translation: v. 处以罚金, 抢夺( mulct的现在分词 )

mulcts.definition:
n money extracted as a penalty
v deprive of by deceit
v impose a fine on
mulcts.translation: v. 处以罚金, 抢夺( mulct的第三人称单数 )
